# Florida Legislature - Online Sunshine

> Florida's official legislative information portal providing comprehensive access to statutes, bills, constitutional documents, and legislative tracking tools.

Online Sunshine serves as the primary public gateway to Florida's legislative documents, statutory law, and bill tracking systems. The site aggregates current and historical legislative information from the Florida Senate and House of Representatives, enabling citizens, researchers, and legal professionals to access Florida statutes, bills, legislative history, and constitutional documents.

## Key Topics

- Florida Statutes

## Legislative Portal & Core Services

- [Welcome - Online Sunshine](https://leg.state.fl.us/index.cfm): Florida Legislature portal providing access to statutes, bills, and legislative information
- [Bill Citator](http://billinfo.leg.state.fl.us): Florida Legislature bill tracking and citator database for legislative history and reports

## Florida Statutes & Constitutional Reference

- [Statutes & Constitution: View Statutes - Chapter 316](https://www.leg.state.fl.us/Statutes/index.cfm?App_mode=Display_Statute&URL=0300-0399/0316/Sections/0316.075.html): Florida Statute Chapter 316 on traffic control signals and motor vehicle regulations
- [Statutes & Constitution: View Statutes - Chapter 196](https://www.leg.state.fl.us/statutes/index.cfm?App_mode=Display_Statute&URL=0100-0199/0196/Sections/0196.031.html): Florida Statute 196.031 on homestead exemption and property tax regulations
- [Statutes & Constitution: View Statutes - Chapter 628](http://www.leg.state.fl.us/statutes/index.cfm?App_mode=Display_Statute&URL=0600-0699/0628/Sections/0628.4615.html): Florida Statute Chapter 628 on insurance law and specialty insurer regulations
